create_LaikagoCommand: create a LaikagoCommand protobuf message to send motor position and velocity commands to the robot
create_LaikagoHighLevelCommand: create a LaikagoHighLevelCommand protobuf message to set walk speed, body height, and foot clearance
create_MotorCommand: create a MotorCommand protobuf message with motor id, position, velocity, and torque values
create_LaikagoState: create a LaikagoState protobuf message to hold IMU data, motor states, and contact states
create_LaikagoHighLevelState: create a LaikagoHighLevelState protobuf message to hold walk speed, COM position, and foot kinematics
